name: Ruchiii
greetingText: I really like your name btw!
wishText:
You’re the reason behind so many smiles, including mine. 🥰 On your special day, I just want to say how amazing you are and how lucky I feel to know you. I hope your day is as beautiful and magical as your smile. 
 Stay adorable—because you’re perfect just the way you are.💕
